annotations.title: Get Underwriter and Placement Agent Statistics

description: Placement agents and underwriters of small-cap offerings (public offerings, registered directs, PIPEs) and how the stock traded after their deals, from published Signal8 dilution snapshots. Without `firm`: the firms by deal count, each with median close-to-close moves on Day 1 and Day 2 from the pricing date, the reference close to Day 20, the median Day 0 open vs the offering price, the share of deals that closed below the offering price by Day 2 and the share with a red Day 1, plus `allFirms` (every deal counted once). With `firm` (a name, abbreviation such as "HCW", or slug): the resolved firm, its full stat block (Day 0 to Day 60 medians and means, offer discount, warrant coverage, deal size vs market value, and the first session from one-minute prices: open and 30-minute high vs the offering price, 30-minute high to the close, last premarket trade vs the offering price), splits by run-up and by material news before pricing, by deal type, size and issuer mix (with `topIssuers`, the companies with 2+ of its deals), `outcomes` (share of its deals after which the company did a reverse split, priced another offering, or received an exchange deficiency notice or was delisted, within 3, 6 and 12 months; the baseline carries the same; facts on record, not a cause; `outcomesByCompany` gives the same shares with each company counted once, n = companies measured), the 3 newest deals (`recentDeals`) and the all-firms baseline. When the name matches several firms or none, `found` is false and `candidates` lists the matches. `includeDeals` adds the full deal list and `includePipeline` adds open ATM / equity-distribution agreements and pending S-1 / F-1 registrations naming the firm (counts for every key). The full deal list and the pipeline rows are included in Signal8 Pro; for other keys they are null with `dealsLocked` / `locked` true. Percent figures are percent. Every median and share carries `n`, the deals measured; a median is null when fewer than 5 deals were measured. A null, absent or withheld value means not measured, not zero and not "none"; a pipeline `registrations` count of null means the S-1 catalog was not available. A deal with several agents counts once for each firm. Each firm row also carries `last12Months` (the same figures over deals priced in the last 12 months) and `roles` (deals led, co-managed, and not determinable, read from the placement-agent text; a role the text does not determine is never counted as led); the firm view adds `headline` (all deals and led-only, all time and last 12 months) and `byYear` (median Day 1 per calendar year). `atmPrograms` counts at-the-market programs naming the firm as ATM sales agent; they are never counted as deals or in any deal figure, and a firm named only as an ATM sales agent can be looked up by name with dealCount 0. Historical figures, not a rating of any firm. An unavailable feature is an HTTP 503 error (FEATURE_DISABLED or UNDERWRITER_STATS_UNAVAILABLE), never an empty list.

firm.description: Firm name, abbreviation or slug (e.g. "Maxim", "HCW", "aegis-capital"). Omit for the firm list.

includeDeals.description: With firm: include the full deal list, newest first (Signal8 Pro).

includePipeline.description: With firm: include open ATMs and pending S-1 / F-1 registrations naming the firm (rows Signal8 Pro).

limit.description: Without firm: firms returned, most deals first (default 25).
